content.short: Harmonix Finance runs automated vault strategies aimed at maximising risk-adjusted returns.
content.description: Harmonix Finance operates automated vault strategies on Hyperliquid, allocating deposits across yield sources under defined risk parameters. The vault format has largely replaced manual yield farming because it moves the burden of monitoring positions from the depositor to the strategy, which is where it belongs.
